title: The Last Paper Boat — Full System E2E 20260902
objective: Create a short coherent three-scene visual story proving the complete studio workflow
brief_text: A quiet, hopeful micro-story told in three visual beats. A child folds a white paper boat beside a misty pond at dawn, sets it on the water, and watches it reach warm sunlight. Keep one recurring white paper boat and a blue raincoat for continuity. No dialogue or on-screen text.
plot_text: Scene 1: At dawn, a child in a blue raincoat finishes folding a white paper boat at the pond edge. Scene 2: The child releases the boat and it begins drifting across calm water. Scene 3: The boat reaches a band of golden sunlight while the child watches from shore, ending on hope.
